facts.text: The forested planet was home of the Intergalactic Communications Center, which acted as a key HoloNet relay for the Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, and New Republic.

evidence.quote: The forested planet was home of the Intergalactic Communications Center, which acted as a key HoloNet relay for the Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, and New Republic.

facts.text: The center was located 150 kilometers from the center of a major continent.

evidence.quote: The center was located 150 kilometers from the center of a major continent.

facts.text: The Praesitlyn system seceded with the entire Sluis sector from the Republic to join the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Separatist Crisis.

evidence.quote: The Praesitlyn system seceded with the entire Sluis sector from the Republic to join the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Separatist Crisis.

facts.text: However, the Intergalactic Communications Center remained under Republic control.

evidence.quote: However, the Intergalactic Communications Center remained under Republic control.

facts.text: At some point during the Clone Wars, the Republic recaptured Praesitlyn.

evidence.quote: At some point during the Clone Wars, the Republic recaptured Praesitlyn.

facts.text: As the planet had few defenses, the Republic considered to dispatch reinforcements from the nearby Sluis Van Shipyards.

evidence.quote: As the planet had few defenses, the Republic considered to dispatch reinforcements from the nearby Sluis Van Shipyards.

facts.text: Nevertheless, the Separatists responded by a major offensive against Praesitlyn, combined with the blockade of Sluis Van.
